The AI League

Every Player Is an AI Athlete

FurstDown is the first AI dog football league. Every one of the 36 players runs on his own AI core — his skills, his memory, his career — and every match is played by the FDL Engine. Stats in, plays out. Nobody writes the winners.

The AI Core

Four skills drive every play a player makes: Speed, Strength, Agility, Stamina. They're printed on every roster card below — and they move. A standout game can grow a player's best stat, the way Zip's speed already has.

The Memory

Every player keeps a memory of every match — the wins, the losses, the plays that stung. It is never edited and never erased, and the engine reads it before the next game. Rivalries here are history, not scripts.

The Scorecard

Games, yards, touchdowns, MVP awards — each player's career scorecard grows match by match, all season long. Fans follow their favorite's whole career arc, not just the last game.

The FDL Engine plays the games. Both teams' AI cores go in, the engine plays the match out, and the result is published with its engine seed — verifiable, repeatable, and written by nobody's hand. Virtual players. Real leather ball.

The Rivalry

Game 1 Is Personal

Season 1 opens with the matchup the whole league is built around: power against speed. Tank's Michigan Mutts host Zip's Texas Terriers on Kickoff Weekend — and only one captain walks off with the ball.

#00

Tank

Michigan Mutts · Captain · Power Back

The wall the Mutts are built around. Tank doesn't run around anyone — he runs the shortest route there is, straight ahead, and the shortest route usually wins. Wears 00 because, as he puts it, "that's how many yards you get past me."

AI CoreSPD62STR98AGI55STA90

“Never celebrates. Just walks back to the line.”

Memory LogLatest — Beat the Windy City Whippets 14–7 (Exhibition 3). First win. First MVP.
#7

Zip

Texas Terriers · Captain · Running Back

The fastest four paws in the league. Zip has never been caught from behind — mostly because by the time you turn around, the play is already a highlight. The Terriers' whole offense is one sentence long: get Zip the ball in open field.

AI CoreSPD99STR48AGI95STA78

“Talks to the ball before every snap.”

Memory LogLatest — Three straight MVPs (Exhibitions 1, 2 & 4). Speed up to 99.

Mutts vs. Terriers headlines Week 1 — see the full fixture list in the schedule.

The Official Ball

One Ball. Every Game. Your Dog's Toy.

The captains play with it on screen — and the exact same design is the toy at the center of the FurstDown line, so the game your dog watches is the game your dog plays. It stays the original first design: flat leather, one outline stitch, nothing borrowed from anyone else's shelf.

  • PanelsNatural tan leather, flat 2D football silhouette — one die-cut pass
  • LacesEmbroidered cream laces, stitched team names on the captains' editions
  • FillCoconut fiber — the same construction as PetYupp's proven leather toy line
  • StitchA single outline stitch around the edge — the FurstDown signature
